name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 7 visits over 34 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 42 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 34 hours starting 2025-08-19, at wavelengths from 0.94 to 4.91 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
